title: 第四章 从了我！
content_zh:
就在这时候——

    洞口的光线忽然被一个黑影挡住了。

    李玉梅的脚步猛地停住，整个人僵在了原地。

    洞口站着一个男人。

    这男人浑身上下湿透了，雨水顺着他的头发和衣角往下淌，在脚下汇成了一小片水洼。

    他显然是冒雨跑过来的，身上的灰色褂子紧紧贴在身上，勾勒出一个粗壮敦实的身形。

    这男人四十来岁，五短身材，肩膀却很宽，脖子粗短，两条胳膊像两根柱子似的，一看就是常年干重活的人。

    可最引人注目的是他那张脸——满脸坑坑洼洼，像是被什么东西啃过一样，密密麻麻的麻子布满了整张面孔，在昏暗的光线下显得格外狰狞。

    尤其此刻他脸上挂着一抹似笑非笑的表情，那双绿豆大的小眼睛里带着不舒服的眼神，更让人觉得这张脸说不出的丑陋可憎。

    这人李玉梅认识，幸福村没有不认识他的。

    赵麻子，大名赵德柱，因为脸上那一脸麻子，村里人都叫他赵麻子。

    说起这赵麻子，在幸福村的名声可不怎么好。

    此人好吃懒做，偷鸡摸狗，仗着自己有两把子力气，在村里横行霸道，没少干欺负人的事。

    前些年因为调戏邻村的一个寡妇，被人家男人找上门来打断了两根肋骨，消停了一阵子，可好了伤疤忘了疼，这两年又开始不老实了。

    李玉梅看见对方的瞬间，心里“咯噔”一下，一种不好的预感涌上心头。

    她强压下心头的慌乱，脸上挤出一丝客气的笑容，“赵麻子……你怎么在这儿？”

    赵麻子没有立刻回答。

    他的目光在李玉梅身上转了一圈，从她被雨水打湿的头发，到微微敞开的领口，再到那双还带着潮红的脸颊，最后落在她身后正傻乎乎站着的王大壮身上。

    不由得嘴角的笑意更深了，露出一口黄牙。
content_en:
Just then——

    The light at the entrance of the cave was suddenly blocked by a dark shadow.

    Li Youmei's footsteps suddenly stopped, and her whole body froze on the spot.

    There was a man standing at the entrance of the cave.

    The man was soaked from head to toe, and the rainwater trickled down his hair and clothes, forming a small puddle at his feet.

    He obviously ran here in the rain. The gray coat clinging tightly to his body outlines a stout and stocky figure.

    This man is in his forties, with a short build, broad shoulders, a short neck, and two arms like two pillars. At first glance, he looks like someone who does heavy work all year round.

    But the most eye-catching thing was his face - it was full of pits and pits, as if it had been chewed by something. The dense pockmarks covered the entire face, which looked particularly ferocious in the dim light.

    Especially at this moment, he had a half-smiling expression on his face, and the uncomfortable look in his small green bean-sized eyes made people feel that this face was indescribably ugly and hateful.

    Li Youmei knew this man, and everyone in Xingfu Village knew him.

    Zhao Mazi, also known as Zhao Dezhu, was called Zhao Mazi by the villagers because of his pockmarked face.

    Speaking of Zhao Mazi, his reputation in Xingfu Village is not very good.

    This person is lazy, sneaky, and uses his own strength to run rampant in the village, often bullying others.

    A few years ago, because he was teasing a widow from a neighboring village, a man came to her house and broke two ribs. He stopped for a while, but the scars healed and he forgot about the pain. In the past two years, he started to be dishonest again.

    The moment Li Youmei saw the other person, her heart skipped a beat, and a bad premonition came to her.

    She suppressed the panic in her heart and forced a polite smile on her face, "Zhao Mazi...why are you here?"

    Zhao Mazi did not answer immediately.

    His eyes moved around Li Youmei, from her rain-wet hair, to her slightly open neckline, to her flushed cheeks, and finally landed on Wang Dazhuang, who was standing stupidly behind her.

    The smile at the corners of his mouth couldn't help but get deeper, revealing yellow teeth.
